mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 66 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. Under the waxing crescent moon, the ISS will be visible tonight starting at 7:40 PM, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward the Home Depot as it passes high in the sky. The low will drop to 48 degrees tonight, and there is no rain expected.

In city news, officers were called to a burglary in progress on September 10th at a home on Hunter's Cove Way. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was located by police and taken into custody, where a handgun was recovered. The suspect was transported for medical treatment and will face charges including burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

There is plenty to do in Verona. The Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival is happening today, and you can enjoy live music today at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company and the Wisconsin Brewing Company on September 15th, or the downtown farmer's market on September 16th.

Regarding the police department's report, on September 10th, officers responded to a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way, which resulted in the apprehension of a suspect and the recovery of a weapon.
If you are looking for a sweet treat, Culver's of Verona is currently open and serving their flavor of the day, Really Reese's. They are open until 10:00 PM, so stop by soon to grab your scoop.
